instruction: The directory kb/ contains a small knowledge base: team.md maps engineers to offices, and each file under kb/projects/ lists hours per engineer for one project. Which office accumulated the most hours across all project files? Answer with the office city. Use the file tools or bash (ls, grep, cat) to find it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
